notes: Movies and Series now open on Recommended, using Movy's featured/popular collections, not personalized predictions. Library still offers release date, alphabetical, popularity, rating and genre filters. Smoother sidebar, page and player-control transitions. Compact Plex-inspired native playback controls replace the crowded top toolbar: transport and timeline, CC and a single Settings button. Settings includes source, language, captions, quality, speed and next episode. New audio sync (+/-2 seconds) and subtitle sync (+/-10 seconds) adjust relative presentation in 0.10-second steps with Reset; positive means later. Timing applies only to this playback, survives source/quality changes and activity recreation, and re-buffers at the current position while preserving pause, speed and track preferences. Existing retained browse navigation, Continue Watching/up-next, native account access and double-Back playback exit remain. Movy remains the source; no visible web-wrapper fallback. Device lip-sync and caption timing still require TV validation.
